title: Joint Exclusivity
abstract: arXiv:2604.17490v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce \emph{joint exclusivity} (JE), a flexible extension of mutual exclusivity for non-negative random vectors that prohibits only the simultaneous positivity of all $n$ components. Unlike mutual exclusivity, JE admits a broad class of marginals while retaining a sharp existence criterion. We prove that a JE random vector with prescribed marginals $F_1,\ldots,F_n$ exists if and only if \[ \sum_{i=1}^n \overline{F}_i(0)\le n-1. \] We also provide a canonical face-based construction with freely specified copulas within each face, and show that the trivariate case can elegantly be reduced to a one-parameter family. Finally, we extend the framework through Wang-type distortions and an $m$-exclusivity hierarchy interpolating between mutual exclusivity and JE.

translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.17490v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们引入了“联合互斥性”（JE），这是非负随机向量互斥性的一种灵活扩展，它仅禁止所有$n$个分量同时为正。与互斥性不同，JE允许广泛的边际分布，同时保持尖锐的存在性准则。我们证明了具有指定边际分布$F_1,\ldots,F_n$的JE随机向量存在，当且仅当\[ \sum_{i=1}^n \overline{F}_i(0)\le n-1. \] 我们还提供了一种基于面的典型构造，每个面内可自由指定copula，并表明三元情况可以优雅地简化为一个单参数族。最后，我们通过Wang型扭曲和介于互斥性与JE之间的$m$-互斥性层次扩展了该框架。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的“联合互斥性”概念，允许非负随机向量中所有分量同时为正被禁止，但保留灵活的边际分布，并给出了存在性准则及构造方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "joint exclusivity," a flexible extension of mutual exclusivity for non-negative random vectors that only prohibits all components being positive simultaneously, with existence criteria and construction methods provided.
